steps.description: Decide if you are creating a Warlord or a Noble. A Warlord can have up to 8 individual points of stat increases; a Noble may only have up to 5 single points of stat increases.
Add Equipment from the armour, weapon and mount tables. Apply any modifiers to their stat line for equipment choices and add the points to their current points total.
Choose extra Abilities. A Warlord can select up to three additional Abilities, and a Noble can select up to two additional Abilities.

character_creator.command_actions: These commanders that you create are eligible to enact Command Actions as described on p.73 of The Barons’ War rulebook.

champions.description: Champions are victors in many trials of combat, perfect for bolstering a group where you don’t add a Commander.
champions.creation: Use the character creator to build a champion and after selecting equipment, roll on their ability table to see which ability they bring when they join their group.

norman: The Champion and his group do not become wearied
The Champion and his group may reroll one die from any roll once per round
The Champion and his group ignore difficult terrain penalties
The Champion and his group may make a free, immediate, move action towards an objective if it is taken by an opponent
The Champion and his group may receive an order without it counting towards the commander's used actions once per game.
viking: The Champion and his group cause Fear
The Champion and his group always attack first in melee combat
The Champion and his group gain an extra attack dice if the group is below 50% of its starting strength
The Champion and his group do not generate morale pips when a member of the group is killed
The Champion and his group must roll 2d6 and choose the highest when making a charge action
saxon: The Champion and his group can defend against '0' results with normal defence successes
The Champion and his group may defend for free whilst holding an objective but cannot charge in the same game round
The Champion and his group gain an extra defence dice if the group is below 50% of its starting strength
The Champion and his group automatically rally in the compulsory action phase
The Champion and his group may choose to push the opponent back d6'' after winning a combat
